newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 30.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* The ringgit retains gains made over last two days. At 0100 GMT, it was at 2.6150/70 to a dollar against 2.6220/50 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday and 2.65 on Monday
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average resumed its uptrend, gaining 53.42 points to a record 8,174.53
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index was up 2.20 points to 1,031.61.
* "The market is still watching the ringgit to find out if the recovery is temporary or will it last," said a dealer with a bank-backed brokerage.
* Rise in Dow unlikely to affect local market much, dealers said.
* Focus expected on speculative counters and low priced second line stocks, they said.
* Chase Perdana, which has announced projects in India, and Telekom, which will announce six-month results on Friday, will be watched closely, dealers said.
